title: Dynamical metric order
summary: We introduce the notion of dynamical metric order of a continuous map on a compact metric space, study its basic properties, and compute it for several classes of maps. This concept which is a counterpart of the metric mean dimension with the role of the box-counting dimension being played by the metric order. It is devised for maps acting on spaces with infinite box-counting dimension but finite metric order.
